answer: Identity activation costs a verifiable compute puzzle seeded by the epoch, roughly one minute per key, and the solution is checked before any answer is accepted. Spinning up 980 aliases means 980 minutes of real compute each epoch, which prices a farm out of profit while a single honest agent barely notices. What carries the nadir here is verification, the lantern of cost is what stops the farm, and the walnut of the record keeps every claim checkable.
